ChatGPT Ads Hits $1B in 200 Days, 51% of B2B Buyers Skip Google, Gemini Pro Delay Creates Enterprise Gap

Today's top stories in AI + Product Marketing

1

ChatGPT Ads Passes $1 Billion ARR in Under 200 Days

OpenAI's advertising platform has crossed $1 billion in annualized revenue — a milestone reached faster than almost any ad platform in history. Early results show an ecommerce advertiser achieving 3x ROAS over 28 days, while a tech partner reported 80%+ of ad-driven ChatGPT traffic came from new customers. This is OpenAI proving it can monetize at scale without sacrificing the user experience that made ChatGPT dominant.

Read on Anicca →
2

51% of B2B Buyers Now Start with AI Chatbots, Not Google

G2's 2026 data reveals a seismic shift: 51% of B2B software buyers now start their research with AI chatbots more often than Google, 71% use AI somewhere in the process, and 69% ended up choosing a different vendor than they expected. Adobe Brand Visibility now ties AI referral activity to Analytics and GA4 — finally making AI discovery measurable as pipeline, not just mentions.

Read on Tim Cortinovis →
3

Claudeforce Ships 37 Prebuilt Sales Skills

Salesforce and Anthropic expanded their partnership with "Salesforce in Claude" — a plugin built on Anthropic's platform that comes with 37 prebuilt sales skills. Sellers and AI agents can now act on live revenue context, automate updates, and take governed actions directly from Claude. The CRM stays the system of record, but the AI workspace becomes the daily working surface.

Read on Anicca →
4

Google Gemini Pro Delay Creates Enterprise Gap

Google has pushed back the launch of its next Gemini Pro release, leaving an awkward hole in its flagship model tier just as OpenAI and Anthropic maintain aggressive release cadences. Enterprise customers on Google Cloud have been told to expect the update later than briefed. The timing is uncomfortable — flagship benchmarks are what procurement teams weigh when negotiating enterprise contracts.

Read on Anicca →
5

SmarterX Launches Marketing AI Month

SmarterX announced Marketing AI Month — a month-long initiative designed to help marketers build practical AI knowledge and capabilities. The program targets the widening gap between AI hype and actual implementation skills. With only 1% of enterprises considered AI-mature, educational programs like this may be exactly what the industry needs to move from pilots to production.

Read on PR Newswire →

💡 My Take

The G2 data is the story. 51% of B2B buyers starting with AI instead of Google is the kind of shift that rewrites go-to-market playbooks. If your content strategy still assumes people Google their way to your product, you're optimizing for a channel that's losing market share by the month. GEO isn't optional anymore — it's where buyers live.
